body.content: The core distinction resolving SCR_001: partial events do not need garbage collection because they were never events. Under proper framing, a partial byte sequence lacks event identity. The resumption protocol simply ignores trailing bytes after the last framed complete event. No append-only violation occurs because no event was deleted or modified—non-events were skipped.
body.possible_next_move: Examine whether the framing protocol in the reasoning envelope provides sufficient delimiters to make the non-event determination deterministic.
body.why_keep_this: Resolves the open question in SCR_001 about orphaned fragments by reframing them as non-events.
